journey.title: Welcome! 🦉
journey.owlText: Hello, friend! Today we are going to learn about reading and writing numbers. This is going to be a fun Math adventure! Are you ready to begin?

journey.title: Today's Mission 🎯
journey.studentText:
By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

✓ Read and write numbers up to 100 in symbols and words
journey.owlText: This is your mission! By the end of this lesson, you will be skilled at reading and writing numbers. Let us begin!

illustration.prompt: A colorful math mission banner for children showing the learning goal: read and write numbers up to 100 in symbols and words, bright engaging colors

journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: Look at the number 45. The digit 4 is in the tens place and the digit 5 is in the ones place. We read it as 'forty-five'.
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about reading and writing numbers. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!

interaction.prompt: What do you already know about reading and writing numbers?
interaction.hint: How do you read the number 67?

journey.title: Real Life Connection 🔗
journey.studentText:
We use reading and writing numbers in everyday life!
